intro.text: Sub-zero winds howl across the frozen wasteland. Station Alpha's colossal light beacon flickers violently under a emerald aurora. As the head beacon engineer, you step off your arctic snow-crawler. Cold-seeking shadow creatures prowl beyond the beam's edge.

choices.text: Climb the ice-slicked beacon tower to repair the fusion igniter
Investigate the sound sensor array near the snow-crawler

sensor_array.text: You recalibrate the sound sensors, acquiring an Acoustic Flare Launcher that drives away shadow creatures with sonic pulses.

choices.text: Take the Acoustic Flare Launcher and climb the beacon tower

beacon_tower.text: At the apex of the tower, the beacon core dies. Total darkness encroaches. Shadows swarm up the scaffolding. A signal arrives from the main colony: 'Sustain the beam or humanity freezes.'

choices.text: Deploy Acoustic Flare Launcher to repel the shadow swarms while fixing the igniter
Overclock your snow-crawler's battery directly into the tower mainframe
Abandon the tower and drive into the frozen dark seeking shelter

ending_dawn.text:
ENDING 1: ETERNAL DAWN
The acoustic flare repels the monsters just long enough for you to fix the fusion igniter. A pillar of brilliant warm light pierces the sky, restoring power and warmth to all surviving human colonies.

ending_silence.text:
ENDING 2: FROZEN SILENCE
The battery overclock ignites a permanent self-sustaining light nova, saving the colony, but freezing your crawler and sealing your heroic legacy in ice.

ending_lost.text:
ENDING 3: SIGNAL LOST
The beacon dies out completely. Darkness swallows Station Alpha as you drift into the endless tundra, leaving humanity's fate uncertain.
